name: Bento reveal
oneLiner: the brand's screen rises out of depth as the hero tile, then glass bento tiles (the author's cut-out, big glyph badges with one-word labels, a counting stat with a sparkline) fly in from every side and snap into dashed slots around it; the grid clacks shut, a light runs across every tile and the hero rims in the accent
say: when the speaker sums up what a product or offer includes ('it writes, it edits, it publishes', 'here is everything you get'): cut in on the product's name, the tiles land one per item, the clack lands on the last word
